proposals.verdict: MINT under discrimination, but READING-ARM GATED
proposals.label: Pleonastic/expletive non read as a real negation
proposals.desc: Reading the non-negating non of finche non and restrictive non...che as an actual negation (comprehension miss).
proposals.flag: Reading-side comprehension miss, like modal_aspect_reading and narrative_imperfect_reading. Gated on the open comprehension-arm question (v15). Mint now if the arm is adopted; else park with the deferred comprehension set.

proposals.label: Wrong member of the bipartite negative
proposals.desc: piu/ancora/mai swapped under non (non fumo ancora for non fumo piu): the no-longer vs not-yet flip. Wrong member of a closed set - textbook paradigm_confusion.

proposals.label: o...o (or e) calqued for ne...ne
proposals.desc: English either...or mapped onto a negated correlative (non bevo o caffe o te for non bevo ne caffe ne te).

proposals.label: Additive echo wrong for polarity
proposals.desc: Anch'io/Anche a me answering a negative that needs neanche: wrong member of the additive-echo set by polarity.

proposals.label: Positive indefinite where the negative is required
proposals.desc: qualcosa/qualcuno where niente/nessuno is required under negation (non voglio qualcosa) - the English 'anything' calque.
proposals.flag: Driver is transfer (English anything), so transfer fits; but the WORD choice (positive vs negative indefinite) is indefinites' territory per the negation/indefinites carve-out, and could sit as paradigm_confusion (wrong polarity member) with a transfer co-tag. Your call on primary family.

proposals.label: mica's function misread
proposals.desc: mica taken as forse, or as a forceful denial in a suppositional question: misreading its function, not choosing a wrong member. A comprehension miss, so discrimination (reading-arm), NOT paradigm_confusion.
proposals.flag: Reading-side, gated on the comprehension-arm question - same gate as pleonastic_non. If the arm is declined, both park.

proposals.resolution: Neanch'io where piacere needs Neanche a me is the piacere agreeing-responses pattern (a-me dative echo). Architecture's lean confirmed. Tag it on the piacere side (paradigm_confusion.clitic_vs_stressed: stressed io/anch'io where the a-me dative is required, OR the piacere bucket's own agreeing-responses). No negation-side mint.

net: 5 new specifics (2 paradigm_confusion, 2 transfer, 1 discrimination-clean) mintable now; 2 reading-side (pleonastic_non, mica) gated on the comprehension arm; 1 folded to piacere. NegationAuthor tags all 19 once the non-gated ones land.
